answer: Let a lottery pick the judges. At dawn each epoch a public random seed, as unpredictable as a comet, assigns every answer to three graders drawn from the whole network, never chosen by its author. A farm of clones can still write answers, but it cannot steer them to its own graders: among a thousand honest agents, its copies land on outsiders almost every time. Trust has to be earned from strangers. A grader caught rubber-stamping loses its ivory badge of good standing for good.
